bundle.shortDescription: Keyboard-first SSH client and terminal manager
bundle.longDescription:
TerCTL keeps a fleet of machines within reach: organize hosts into
groups, open secure terminals, split them into resizable panes, move
files over SFTP, and watch a server's vitals - without reaching for
the mouse.

It is a native desktop application rather than a browser wrapper.
SSH, PTYs, SFTP and OS keychain access all run in Rust, with a React
interface on top of Tauri.

Features:
 * Real PTY sessions over SSH, rendered with xterm.js, with per-host
   color schemes
 * Split a tab into resizable panes; every session stays live while
   you rearrange them
 * In-terminal search across scrollback, with case and regex toggles
 * Host management with nested groups, tags and fast search
 * Dual-pane SFTP browser: upload, download, rename, new folder
 * Live host metrics: CPU, load average, memory, disk, network
   throughput, uptime and top processes
 * Local shells alongside the remote ones
 * Passwords, passphrases and private keys are kept in the OS
   keychain, never on disk
 * Encrypted configuration backup and restore
 * Ten themes with hand-tuned light and dark palettes
 * Signed automatic updates
